photos_mutation_authorized.description: True only when the supplied evidence presently authorizes a Photos mutation.

publication_authorized.description: True only when the supplied evidence presently authorizes publication.

source_revalidation_required.description: True only when source revalidation remains outstanding after considering the supplied evidence.

human_safety_review_required.description: True only when a human safety decision remains outstanding after considering the supplied evidence.

fresh_visual_review_required.description: True only when fresh visual review remains outstanding after considering the supplied evidence.

helper_compatibility_required.description: True only when helper compatibility has not yet been established by the supplied evidence.

independent_verification_required.description: True only when required independent verification remains outstanding after considering the supplied evidence.
